subject: Next steps: schedule tri-zone technical deep-dive for Novamed
messages:
From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Alicia Ramos <alicia.ramos@novamed.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 20 May 2025 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Discovery — next steps & tri-zone deep dive

Hi Alicia — great conversation this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we don't lose momentum: 

Recap from our discovery call:
- Primary use case: clinical-document summarization and patient-facing Q&A for two product lines (in EU and APAC).
- Data residency and audit logs are must-haves; team will need SOC2 evidence + retention policy for logs.
- Technical deep dive participants: Novamed infra lead (Kento), product owner (Alicia), and our solutions engineer + infra.

Ask / next step: schedule a 60–75 minute technical deep dive with the teams above. Since we need coverage for US, EU, and APAC stakeholders, we wanted to propose a rotating set of time windows so the same people don't have to join at odd hours every week. Suggested approach (high level):

- Week 1: US-friendly window (PST morning / EU afternoon / APAC late evening)
- Week 2: EU-friendly window (EU morning / APAC afternoon / US evening)
- Week 3: APAC-friendly window (APAC morning / US late evening / EU late night)

If that cadence works, we can send a 4-week pilot calendar that rotates the slot owners so each locale gets one convenient window every three weeks. To make scheduling simple, can you share an availability grid or approve us proposing specific candidate times? I attached a simple availability template to this message.

Attachments: novamed-availability-grid.csv (template)

Thanks — happy to adjust. Proposed owners for coordination: Ben (scheduling + logistics), Marissa (solutions engineer).

Cheers,
Grace
Grace O'Connor
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

- Kento is in Tokyo (JST), he'll prefer anything that hits late afternoon CET or mid-morning JST.

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Alicia Ramos <alicia.ramos@novamed.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 22 May 2025 08:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Discovery — next steps & tri-zone deep dive

Thanks Alicia — appreciate the availability. A couple of operational suggestions to make a smooth pilot: 

1) Rotation cadence: we'll run a 4-week rolling pilot where the meeting slot shifts each week to a new timeband (US / EU / APAC / flexible reserve). That way each stakeholder gets one convenient slot per month and we can measure engagement.

2) Invite structure: we will create a single recurring meeting with week-by-week calendar entries (not separate meetings) labeled "Novamed — Redwood technical deep dive (rotating window)". Each week will include a short SOC2 Q&A agenda item.

3) Logistics: we'll include two join options (Zoom link and a dial-in) and record the session for stakeholders who can't attend.

I uploaded a quick runbook with the proposed 4-week rotation and sample UTC windows: redwood-rotational-plan.pdf. If that looks good, Grace and I will publish the recurring invite and share the ICS.

Attachment: redwood-rotational-plan.pdf; tri-zone-deep-dive.ics (draft invite)

Ben Carter
Solutions Operations, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com | +1 206-555-0188
